Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Park <sara@healthsync.com>, HealthSync IT <it@healthsync.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Subject: POC rapid onboard: connectivity, API keys & close timeline

Hi Sara / HealthSync IT team,

Thanks for the productive demo last week — excited to move into a short MAP to get the POC running quickly. Attached is a one-page MAP (MAP-HealthSync-v1.pdf) and a simple VPC diagram (vpc-diagram.png) showing the topology we recommend. High-level asks to get the environment live: 

- API access: Redwood will provision a scoped API key for the POC (read/write inference) and a short-lived admin key for initial scaffolding. We need a user email to attach the org invite.
- Org setup: Please confirm the admin email you want invited to the Redwood org. We'll send an invite with minimum roles.
- IP allowlist: share the public egress IPs (CIDR) that need to be permitted; we will whitelist those on our side and provide our outbound IPs for your firewall.
- VPC peering: if you prefer VPC peering, please share the peering window (UTC) and your VPC ID. We support both static route and BGP-style peering — tell us which you prefer.

Tentative timeline: complete connectivity and keys this week so you can run a small workload next week. Proposal: peering window Fri 07/29 02:00-04:00 UTC (if that works for you).

Can you confirm the egress CIDRs and the admin email to invite? I attached the MAP with an explicit checklist.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

I'll attach a small firewall-snippet.txt showing the rules we'll add on our side. Our network engineer (it@healthsync.com) is CC'd here for the peering handoff.

Thanks for the details — looping in the recommended execution steps so everyone has a clear checklist. (Quoted below for context.)

Execution checklist (POC scope):
- Org invite: we will invite alice.jung@healthsync.com to the Redwood POC org. Role: Org Admin (temporary, can be downgraded after setup).
- API keys: create via Redwood Console > Org > API Keys. We'll create a scoped key named "healthsync-poc-temp" with 7-day expiry and delivery via secure link (DocuSign-like link). If you prefer an alternate delivery method (your vault or SFTP), confirm.
- IP allowlist: we will add 34.210.32.0/22 and 3.92.128.0/18 to our inbound allowlist for the key binding. We will provide our outbound egress IPs after peering completes.
- VPC peering: since you prefer static-route peering, network team to exchange VPC IDs and route table entries. Target window: Fri 2027-07-29 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please share a primary contact for the window (name + mobile).
- Smoke test: after peering and keys are in place, we'll run a 30-min smoke run with a small requests set and validate latency and model responses.

Notes: If any of these steps must be executed outside the window because of change freeze, call that out and we'll work an alternate schedule.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
